quality_notes: ONS territorial, residence or production, and consumption or footprint accounting bases remain explicitly separate.
ONS scheduled revisions, corrections and current editions remain distinct from superseded versions.
DfT SAF and RTFO fifth-provisional 2025 data remain provisional; November 2026 final releases remain future and are not treated as observed.
DfT vehicle licensing and EV charging infrastructure remain stock, activity or infrastructure evidence rather than direct greenhouse-gas measurements.
Ofgem BUS applications, vouchers, grants, eligibility and guidance remain administration or policy evidence rather than measured emissions reductions.
DESNZ conversion factors and UK ETS factors remain calculation/reporting tools; UK ETS market prices and allowances remain market/compliance evidence rather than physical parcel emissions.
DESNZ local-authority aggregates and National Data Library surfaces remain subnational aggregate evidence and are not assigned to individual parcels.
Defra consumption-footprint statistics and correction history remain distinct from territorial and residence accounting.
Publication date, reference period, provisional/final state, unit, denominator, stock/flow, geography and method version are explicitly guarded.
Official-page licensing/attribution metadata is preserved where exposed; web HTML bytes were not downloaded or content-hashed.
No unsupported conversion, future-release observation, policy-to-measurement substitution or individual parcel emissions value was inferred or produced.
